source.redistribution_note: BLS-published material is public domain except identified third-party material. Attribute the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, retain archive URLs and release dates, and do not use the protected BLS emblem.

interval.availability_rule: Each selected BLS PPI release explicitly states that transmission is embargoed until 8:30 a.m. EDT on its named release date. FinReplay validates the weekday and EDT abbreviation against America/New_York, cross-checks the archived HTML and PDF, and makes the snapshot eligible at that exact time. Current retrieval metadata is never backdated.

payload.covid_methodology_statement: The Producer Price Index (PPI) response rates for April were consistent with those of March and February, and no changes in estimation procedures were necessary.
payload.ppi_measurement_boundary: average change over time in prices received by domestic producers; seller perspective
payload.snapshot_semantics: headline final-demand monthly change reported in this archived release

claim_boundary: This lock preserves the originally released -130-basis-point April 2020 final-demand monthly change solely as a post-decision event. The unchanged -20-basis-point March prior value and the 110-basis-point shortfall below the fixed lower endpoint are retained for an exact breach check. The event is excluded from all ReplayPack inputs and does not establish forecast skill, calibrated coverage, producer-level behavior, pandemic or market causality, investment performance, external review, deployment, or user impact.
